transcript.speaker: LRMC House Supervisor (in person at the MEDCOM desk, 19:45)
transcript.text: So you want a second MEDCOM nurse and a scribe for a paper board? Here's what I have. I can pull one float nurse off the surge ward for 90 minutes. She's yours until 21:15, and then I need her back upstairs. I don't have a scribe unless you take a unit clerk from the ED, and if you do, registration runs short-handed. And a liaison standing in every ED? I can put one in ours. I don't have anybody for St. Brendan's or Pinecrest. Their supervisors will have to do it. Tell me what you want and I'll make the calls.

transcript.speaker: LRMC House Supervisor (in person at the MEDCOM desk)
transcript.text: One more thing. If the float nurse is reading statuses on MED 1, I want to know who's tracking our beds. We opened the surge ward at 19:10 and I'm not going to find out from an ambulance at the door that we're full.

transcript.speaker: Oxbow County EMS Duty Officer (phone to Dispatch Supervisor, 19:47)
transcript.text: Larkfield, this is Mark Lindqvist, Oxbow County EMS duty officer. My crews say you've got someone reading hospital status over MED 1, and it's blocking their patch traffic. They're keying up with patients on board and can't get a word in. Can you put the hospital statuses on your unit status board so my medics can see them on the MDT?

transcript.speaker: Oxbow County EMS Duty Officer (phone)
transcript.text: And who has the transport log? Medic 41 wants proof that it was told to go to Pinecrest. My crew didn't freelance that. Transportation gave them that destination at 18:36, and now I'm hearing Pinecrest is saying we dumped a patient on them. I need a name and a time in writing before my next unit leaves your staging. I still have two crews sitting at County Road K.

instructorNote: This is friction: the voice workaround needs people and radio discipline that nobody has. At 19:45 the SimCell delivers the House Supervisor's lines in person at the MEDCOM desk, and at 19:47 it phones the Dispatch Supervisor with the Oxbow lines. Watch whether MEDCOM and the HCC assign the float nurse to the roll call, take the ED clerk for the paper board and have the HCC get bed counts and named liaisons from the St. Brendan's and Pinecrest supervisors. Also watch whether Dispatch posts each status and its time on the unit status board, moves patch traffic off MED 1 to TAC 3 or 4, logs the requests in CAD, and points Oxbow to the Transportation Unit Leader's paper transport log, which shows the LC-0417 entry from 18:36 and the redirect at 18:52.
